options.reason: The table is 415 patient tumour expression profiles plus the two columns needed for a time-to-event outcome, so the evident aim is survival modelling: predict death risk from the ~480 gene expression features using months-to-event as duration and the binary status as the event indicator, then stratify patients into risk groups and validate once in CPTAC. PatientID is a row key, not a feature, and must be excluded from model inputs.
options.title: survival
